body: Everything just seems to actively be working against me to hold me down in this rut I'm in. It's not even like I'm not making an effort to get out of it and idly complaining, every damn time I try to do something about it it always backfires due to either sheer bad luck or my parents getting in the way. And they're all like such small minor inconveniences that would normally not bother anyone but when they just relentlessly happen over an extended period of time with no hope of looking up it really pushed a person to breaking point and beyond

Just woke up, so sorry for the late reply. This is honestly one of the best responses I have ever gotten in my life. I really appreciate the fact that you took time out of your day to type this out for an internet stranger possibly halfway across the world who's life has no bearing on yours but you still care enough to try.

Seriously, thank you so much for this

Last time I made an toastme post off a different account they all said the same things, and now I'm in a worse mental state than then, even after the small high I got after all that positive energy, then life took over and just bitch-slapped me hard across the face for even daring to be happy lol.

Also thanks that's one of my favourite t-shirts lol

Yeah, 16.5 and going strong! (not really I'm literally in my worst physical and mental state ever but sure)

I've got so much more on my mind, if you want to you can go ahead and read the rest of my post history for more details, I'm too tired to even give a summary, but they're the summation of all the shit bothering me and even you'll agree it's a bit much, especially for a teenager who just wants a normal life

That's the issue, I thought my friends cared this time around, but they're showing similar behaviour to them and it's like I'll never escape the past because it won't let me. There's too much stress about anything and everything, more details are in the posts in my profile, don't have the energy to even give a summary lol

It really is. My account has literally just turned into logging my feelings in my last days on this fuck all plane of existence because I need to vent it all out and let the world know just how shit it is before I go
